# Rescue the Shelter Hold in the human start instance (block 0x0299): the placements no capture
# of the human Shelter holds. The quest runs on them from the emote tables (`quest_emotes`).
# `Network/prepare_content.py --strip-training-placements` appends these rows to the prepared world
# after it strips the training kit's placements and mirrors the captured 0x0298 Shelter into 0x0299.
# Captured (retail): the Menhir Shard, copied from block 0x028D (an identical copy of this
# dungeon; capture-spawns-upstream.tsv 8140a5e59b5fb846, name "Menhir Shard") to the same
# cell-local place in cell 0x014D, the isolated shard room where the Advance Shelter Scout stands.
# Inferred from the DAT dungeon (Pyrealium reconstruction; no capture of these exists):
# - The Menhir Portal (wsl_genericportal_pink, as both captured Shelter portals): at the second
#   `bd_emp_portal` arch (EnvCell static 0x47000398, cell 0x0116 (146.80, 629.85, -30.80)) at
#   the far end of the halls ("near the outer reaches of the Hold", the Menhir Glyph's
#   description), raised 0.98 m above its arch as the captured quick exit at the first arch
#   (cell 0x0120) is. Name: the DAT's "Menhir Portal" (portal string table 0x2500158C).
# - Training Stones 7 to 9 (Examination and Vitals, Looting, Vulnerable Targets; captured
#   stones 1 to 6 end in cell 0x0104): in the tunnel after stone 6, before the Shelter Sentry
#   (the Lieutenant: "The next Training Stones are down the tunnel ... When you are finished,
#   speak to the Shelter Sentry").
# - The Shelter Sentry ("The Drudges are up ahead!"), then the Drudge Diggers in the tunnel
#   and its side alcove, then the Shelter Scout at the tunnel's end ("Did you find any tools on
#   the Drudge Diggers you passed through?"), then the Drudge Sentinels in the large room beyond
#   her (AC2Hero, AC2 Vault "Rescue the Shelter Hold"). Counts are Pyrealium policy.
# Each place is a floor point of AC2_Rusted's physics (a human body dropped there settles on the
# floor of that cell, touching no wall or static), at least 1.6 m clear around, 4 m or more from
# every other placement, the tunnel ones 2.5 m or more from the cell's statics (arches,
# mushrooms, stalagmites: none stands in a passage), and 1.5 to 8 m from the walked route
# (Guard -> Lieutenant -> tunnel -> large room -> stairs -> rotunda arch), facing the route.
# AC2_Rusted's live test `pyrealium_live_shelter` walks that route and plays the quest on these rows.
# IID entity visual cell X Y Z W QX QY QZ scale name (tab-separated)
